subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core status/remove and persisted ownership contract as part of the Claws RFC stack, rather than keeping lifecycle ownership outside the core until the contract is approved?
rationale: The PR is technically substantial but establishes durable deletion, recovery, and package-ownership semantics across several unmerged prerequisites; this is a product and ownership choice, not a mechanical contributor follow-up.

options.title: Sponsor the lifecycle stack
options.body: Approve the experimental core direction after the linked prerequisites, recovery semantics, and missing cleanup-path evidence are reviewed together.

options.title: Land read-only visibility only
options.body: Keep `claws status` while deferring destructive removal and ownership cleanup until the RFC contract is settled.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Leave the series unmerged until maintainers choose a different lifecycle and persistence boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the lifecycle stack
recommendation.body: Approve the experimental core direction after the linked prerequisites, recovery semantics, and missing cleanup-path evidence are reviewed together.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent shared-state, config, and fs-safe ownership is the closest current-main boundary for the decision.
